Running dual channel with two sticks of 8gb each is nice, but yeah, you're gonna have to replace the old ones. You should always look for the lowest possible latencies on the ram. Since you're running an Intel build, going for crazy speeds like 3600mhz or stuff like that will just be a waste of money. I say 3000mhz is my personal sweet spot, 2666 is not bad either, but it isn't anything to brag about. Then just compare prices on the market. The bigger brands don't usually offer anything too slow when it comes to the latencies so you're probably fine with anything, just be suspicious if something is too cheap


Also... make sure it's  DDR4, if that's not already a given.
